notes:
The report is not ready as it stands. I found 40 concrete errors in the hand-written parts, all with exact replacements, and 13 groups of problems in the generated entries. Every replacement text occurs exactly once in its file. I also applied all 40 to a copy of the parts and inputs in the scratchpad and ran report.py there: it renders without unknown tokens (151 findings). I modified no repository file.

The problems that matter most:
- Section A says the six 'before finished' packages hold 'most of the S2s'. They hold 7 of the 15.
- G.2's package lists leave out the five late entries: CL-GEO-11, CL-UX-21, CL-UX-22, CL-TEST-21, CL-ROB-13.
- WP-04's refit effort is given as 3-5 days; CL-GEO-01's own entry says 3-8 days.
- A and J say every area finding was verified. Three of the five unverified entries are area findings (the completeness critic's).
- A says each entry 'shows both the area's claim and the correction'. report.py shows only the merged fields, and 19 of the 30 weakened entries record no reason.
- The origin counts in A and J (111 + 18 + 3) leave out 19 of the 151 findings.
- 'Accepted 4,033 ms' (in A and question 274) misreads decision 267 (a). Section 23.2 left that visibility issue open for this audit.
- E.2 repeats three claims the verifiers weakened or refuted: 'only on a popular website', 'contradicts the register's A readings', and 'Seven figures contradicted'. It also drops one of the twelve failed consistency claims.
- Question 270 (b) proposes giving the frozen archive builds the integrity attribute. That contradicts CL-ROB-06's remedy and CLAUDE.md.
- Question 283 has 611,017 bytes; the evidence says 611,113.
- Question 276 cites the wrong decisions (113-118).
- D.2a's 'the largest' ceiling raise is wrong: the orbit-with-selection ceiling rose more than Play's.
- F.1's 53/43 claims count does not match the ledger.json it cites, which holds 51/41.
